scope: Priority 4: source labels, provenance, construction, review sampling, duplicate and cohort sensitivities; no model inference or benchmark relabeling
sampling: Independent simple random samples without replacement within each of seven model/dataset/error cells; merge selected sample IDs for review, retain per-cell inclusion probabilities. Principal four combinations have 240 selections before merging. Do not infer a population error rate from the raw review fraction.
purposive_review: Separately select minimum-score FN, maximum-score FP and highest parser-error function per job; exclude from population estimates.
grouping: Exact source SHA256; comment/whitespace-free tree-sitter leaf-token SHA256 preserving literals; structural candidate SHA256 replacing identifier leaf types with placeholders. Structural groups are candidate near-duplicates, not semantic equivalence. No exhaustive fuzzy clone claim.
weighting: Original rows and fractional weight 1/group_size within each dataset for each grouping. Keep conflicting labels and scores; never arbitrarily select a representative label. Strict score >0.5, existing checkpoints and probabilities.
cohorts: Language, authorship strength/type, analyzer vote count/rule/CWE, source parse and function boundaries, project, exact overlap exclusion. Report support/prevalence; associations only.
uncertain_records: Profile all 2679 excluded records, including language/project/length/analyzer/authorship and input structure; no invented binary labels or F1.
external_manual_review: Verify identifiers and code against local LLMVul, report every published rater value, recompute nominal kappa and complete binary-case kappa separately. No interpretation or recoding of undocumented -1; no missing consensus invented. Evaluate only exactly matched agreed binary cases as a selected-subset sensitivity.
independent_review: Create blinded code package and separate source-evidence stage, two blank reviewer forms, coordinator key and adjudication schema. This assistant is not two independent qualified reviewers. No agreement or error-rate estimate from uncompleted forms.
cweval: Inspect pinned task/test provenance and map tests to extracted functions. Execute only if an isolated supported runtime is present. Record unavailable execution explicitly.
preservation: Hash source data, historical predictions and priority 2 joined scores before and after; preserve historical RQ1 reports and datasets. All outputs use new priority 4 paths.
